title: Hunts FH-038S: Offer admin screen and order settlement call for store items

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail:
Add the screen where a Space owner approves a store item for a Hunt (writes hunt_store_offers), render the deep link through resolveStoreLink, and call planOrderProjection and projectUnit from the commerce order settlement and refund paths. Done when: a quantity-two bound line replayed gives two benefits and a refunded unit revokes only its own. Requires: FH-038, FH-037S. Owner role: Commerce.

Built 2026-11-11 (part): lib/hunts/order-hooks.ts projects a settled commerce order through planOrderProjection and projectPlan (one benefit per unit of a bound line, replay-safe), and the Stripe webhook calls it after recordCommerceOrderFromSession, on charge.refunded and on charge.dispute.closed (full refund or lost dispute revokes, a partial refund opens a review case, a won dispute restores only while the order is paid). Dark until HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED, best effort. Still open: the Space-owner screen that approves a store item for a Hunt (writes hunt_store_offers), the resolveStoreLink deep link render, and the order checkout-return call. The verify file lib/hunts/merch-hooks.ts is deliberately not created until those land.
